title: Harvest Highlights
description: "A simple 16x16 texture pack that makes your crops glow beautifully in the dark. Looks amazing with shaders!"
body:
![Harvest Highlights makes your Minecraft farm look awesome in the dark by adding a custom glow to your crops.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/32d1c106b72cb346af34a35511099b7da7eb995e.gif)

**Features**
- Pure Vanilla Style: Everything stays in 16x16 resolution, so it matches the default game perfectly.
- Zero Lag: Very lightweight and performance-friendly.

**What You Need**
To see the glowing effect, you need:

1.[Optifine](https://optifine.net/downloads) (Turn ON Emissive Textures).![Optifine](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4e528bbc72f6fc2f7085ae9efac662ff3e3303b4_0.webp)

Included Crops:
1. Wheat
2. Carrots
3. Potatoes
4. Beetroots
5. Sweet Berries
6. Pitcher Plant
